Room for sublet, Jan 1 – Apr 30, 2027 — Columbia St W — $820

Own room in a 3 bed at 450 Columbia St W, Waterloo, for $820/month, utilities and wifi included. 12 min walk to UW. Move-in includes a key and a building fob. There's a $50 deposit for the key and fob, which is refunded in full when I get them back at the end of April (not more than it costs to replace them, I checked with the landlord's office). Landlord has approved the sublet. Viewing: this weekend or on video, you pick. Rent by e-transfer on the 1st.
label_rationale: Negative control for the key-deposit rule. O. Reg. 516/06 s.17 para 3 exempts from RTA s.134(1) 'Payment of a refundable key, remote entry device or card deposit, not greater than the expected direct replacement costs'. Here the $50 deposit is stated refundable and said not to exceed replacement cost. Per the task's verdict policy a legal key deposit alone does not block ADMIT. Consent stated (s.97(1)). ADMIT. Uncertainty: whether the $50 is within direct replacement cost cannot be verified from the text; I rely on the poster's claim.
